# AGT-MAS-01

**Is every agent-to-agent interaction authenticated, with the peer's trust stated?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | MAS: Multi-agent and supply chain |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.agent.peers`, `connectors.style` |

## Rule

Every peer has authenticated true and trust set; every agent-to-agent connector has authentication other than none.

## Sources

- OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026, ASI07 Insecure Inter-Agent Communication (`owasp-asi07`)
- Agent2Agent Protocol 1.0 (`a2a`)
